    The problem

    Every conversation starts from nothing.

    You re-explain the project. You paste the same brief again. The decision from last week stayed in the chat, not in your assistant.

    Context
    Rebuilt by hand for every conversation, in every app, from the first sentence.
    Decisions
    The reasoning behind them survives only in your head, never in the tool you use.
    Knowledge
    Locked inside one assistant's history, invisible to the next one you open.
    Ownership
    Cloud memory means an account, a server and a retention policy that is not yours.

    The mechanism

    One engine between every app and your disk.

    Your assistants speak MCP. KEPTA answers, and keeps a single encrypted file. The same code path serves the apps, the HTTP API and the browser, so every client gets the same answers.

    connect your apps
    # finds Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI and more
$ npx -y kepta-mcp setup
    open your memory
    # the same encrypted file, in your browser, live
$ npx -y kepta-mcp ui

    Sealed

    One file. Yours.

    The knowledge base is a single encrypted database. The key is created and held by your operating system, so no assistant ever sees it.

    At rest
    SQLCipher 4: AES-256 with an HMAC-SHA512 over every page, the write-ahead log included.
    The key
    256 random bits, created and kept in the macOS Keychain, Windows DPAPI or the Linux Secret Service.
    Exposure
    Loopback only, 127.0.0.1. There is no server that could receive your notes, because there is no server.
    Telemetry
    None. No account, no analytics, no call home. This page runs no tracking either.
    Licensing
    A key is verified offline on your device with an Ed25519 signature, bound to your name. The app never locks and your data is never a hostage.

    It remembers in time

    Ask what you knew on any day.

    Facts carry validity windows. When one is replaced, the old one is marked and kept, never quietly deleted. Drag the date and watch the file tell you the truth as it stood.

    Validity
    Every note can carry valid_from and valid_to, and answers a query for a past moment.
    Supersede
    A new fact displaces the old one and points to it, so the reasoning stays traceable.
    Weighting
    Expired and replaced notes lose relevance in ranking, but never disappear from the file.

      Three ways to remember

      Three ways in, one ranked answer.

      Full text, meaning and connection are searched at once, fused into one ranking, and re-ranked on your machine. Nothing is sent away.

      Full text

      Exact words

      BM25 finds the phrase you actually used: the name, the number, the reference.

      Meaning

      Close enough

      Vector similarity finds the note that says it differently, in another language if needed.

      Connection

      Linked in

      The knowledge graph follows the links between notes, so a hit brings its neighbours.

      Fusion

      One ranking

      The three are fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, then re-ranked locally by term coverage, phrases, title and tags.

      The evidence

      The memory, made visible.

      KEPTA Pro is the desktop app on the same engine: what your notes contain, how they connect, and which assistant touched them.

      • 01

        The interface

        Browse by kind and tag, search ranked by relevance, write and edit.

      • 02

        The knowledge graph

        Every note a node, every link an edge, with a time slider for any day.

      • 03

        Today

        What changed since your last visit, and what needs a look.

      • 04

        Activity

        Which assistant read or wrote what, live, while you talk to it.

      • 05

        The editor

        A note with its kind, tags and validity window, written by you or by an assistant.

      • 06

        Setup

        A first-run assistant with a starter pack, and a check for a local model.
